style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Natural Feel Pre-Lit Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Transform your home with the enchanting beauty of this artificial 150cm natural feel garland with lights. This stunning garland features lifelike frosted greenery and natural accents, capturing the essence of the outdoors while adding a touch of festive charm to any space. The integrated lights emit a soft, warm glow, creating a magical atmosphere that’s perfect for holiday celebrations, special events, or adding a cosy ambiance year-round. Whether draped along your mantel, wrapped around a staircase railing, or hung above doorways, this versatile garland brings the perfect balance of elegance and warmth to your décor. At 150cm, it’s the ideal length to make a statement in any room, making your space feel inviting and full of seasonal cheer. .Garland Length: L150cm. .2x AA batteries required. Batteries not included. Matching wreath available. .Recommended indoor use only.
